name: Ink
pitch: A calm, reflective talk about hard-won lessons, where each slide holds one thought and a lot of silence around it.

illustration.medium: flat vector, ink-and-brush illustration on warm rice-paper cream
illustration.line: variable-width brush strokes, 1 to 4px, tapered ends like real ink
illustration.shapes: a single confident brush stroke or seal-mark motif, lots of empty space around it
illustration.texture: faint paper grain, occasional ink-bleed edge
illustration.palette_use: warm cream background dominant, near-black ink, one vermilion red used sparingly like a seal stamp
illustration.avoid: gradients, digital UI chrome, neon color, symmetry, clutter
